summary: A local end-to-end research demonstration now loads real CT patches, runs the original C++ model and displays genuine predictions. Native GPU execution was separately verified on a Tesla T4. Useful whole-scan quality and full-size numerical agreement remain unresolved. This public site displays files locally; it does not provide online inference.
registered_tests: 52/52 regressions passed; full-size reference comparison remains open
whole_volume: Evaluation implemented; useful whole-scan quality unproven

build.cuda: Small-model hardware gate passed; full-size reference agreement unresolved

whole_volume_result.scope: exclusive foreground mean over a complete held-out scan; not comparable to the targeted GPU patch score

active_training.description: The bounded local research demo is verified and ready for presentation. No training run is active. Full-size numerical disagreement and weak held-out quality remain the next engineering focus; this page is a published snapshot.

gpu_training.backend: CUDA convolution; CPU normalization, loss and Adam
gpu_training.public_summary: Native forward/backward and checkpoint-resume checks passed on Tesla T4 hardware. Three real-data training updates completed. The session is stopped; full-size reference agreement and performance work remain.

client_preview.summary: Browse full CT scans and select separately labelled reference or supplied prediction overlays locally. No online inference or upload.

next_milestones: Rehearse the verified local research demo, then agree customer acceptance criteria.
Resolve the full-size reference discrepancy and measure GPU performance.
Demonstrate learning on independent full scans with agreed acceptance criteria.
Begin a customer pilot only after quality, data and operational gates are met.

latest_completed_gpu_training.checkpoint_resume: Checkpoints saved. Exact resume passed in the separate small-model GPU gate; this real run was not separately resumed.
latest_completed_gpu_training.quality: Only three fixed, class-targeted held-out patches were evaluated. Kidney improved, tumor declined slightly and cyst changed little. No whole-scan evaluation was performed in this GPU probe. This is execution evidence, not useful masking accuracy.

local_research_demo.summary: The local research demo loads a saved native checkpoint and returns fresh CPU predictions for a training patch and a separate held-out patch. Sixty-four fixed-patch updates reduced training loss from 2.1668 to 0.6646. Training-patch kidney/tumor Dice is 0.9476/0.9034, but held-out patch Dice is only 0.1541/0.2399. Neither selected patch contains cyst labels. These results do not establish whole-scan quality.

investor_preview.execution: recorded native results; no live public inference
